lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: Eleven years this place has been shut and the pick list is still running. I come in for the parts and I stay out of aisle nine.

lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: Aisle nine is filing. Actual paper filing, under guard, in a distribution warehouse. Ask yourself what gets filed in a shed.

lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: You went in. Nine pages, was it? People have been guessing about aisle nine for a decade and it is nine pages.
